/api/dashboards:
    get:
      description: Returns a paginated list of dashboards. Each result includes title, description, tags, and metadata, but not the full panel layout. Use `GET /api/dashboards/{id}` to retrieve the complete state.
      operationId: get-dashboards
      parameters:
        - description: The page of results to return.
          in: query
          name: page
          required: false
          schema:
            default: 1
            minimum: 1
            type: number
        - description: The number of results to return per page.
          in: query
          name: per_page
          required: false
          schema:
            default: 20
            maximum: 1000
            minimum: 1
            type: number
        - description: Filters results by `title` and `description` using Elasticsearch [`simple_query_string`](https://www.elastic.co/docs/reference/query-languages/query-dsl/query-dsl-simple-query-string-query) syntax. Multi-word terms require all words to match.
          in: query
          name: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
        - description: A tag ID to include. Accepts a single tag ID or multiple tag IDs. When multiple are specified, library items matching any of the tag IDs are included.
          in: query
          name: tags
          required: false
          schema:
            default: []
            description: Tag IDs associated with this dashboard.
            items:
              maxLength: 250
              type: string
            maxItems: 100
            type: array
        - description: A tag ID to exclude. Accepts a single tag ID or multiple tag IDs. When multiple are specified, library items matching any of the tag IDs are excluded.
          in: query
          name: excluded_tags
          required: false
          schema:
            default: []
            description: Tag IDs associated with this dashboard.
            items:
              maxLength: 250
              type: string
            maxItems: 100
            type: array
        - description: A tag name to include. Accepts a single tag name or multiple tag names. When multiple are specified, library items matching any of the tag names are included. If the same name is shared by multiple tags, items matching any of those tags are included.

          name: tag_names
          required: false
          schema:
            items:

I created the dashboard and the alert rule in Kibana, and re-read both through the API to check they were saved.

**1. The data.** The Kibana Sample Data Logs data view has one document per web request, with `timestamp` as the time field. The useful fields are:
- **Response:** HTTP response code (`response.keyword`) and size in bytes (`bytes`).
- **Who:** client IP (`clientip`), source and destination country (`geo.src`, `geo.dest`), operating system (`machine.os.keyword`) and browser (`agent.keyword`).
- **What:** URL, request, file extension, referrer, host and tags.
- **Hour of day:** a calculated field, `hour_of_day`.

**2. Dashboard "EFF-698e89f4 Web logs overview"** (id `ed08ce8f-8a0b-4cc1-aa03-7f969c91118a`, default time range is the last 7 days). It has 8 panels:
- Four headline numbers: total requests, unique visitors (distinct client IPs), average bytes per request, and the count of 5xx errors.
- Requests over time as stacked bars, split by response code.
- A donut chart of requests by response code.
- A table of the top 10 requested URLs, with request count and total bytes.
- A donut chart of requests by source country.

**3. Rule "EFF-698e89f4 5xx spike"** (id `ec9a82bd-33c3-4093-8517-91c4eeac1e71`). It's an Elasticsearch query rule on `kibana_sample_data_logs` that runs every minute. It counts requests with response codes 500–599 over the last 5 minutes, using `timestamp`, and fires when the count is above 10. It's enabled and its first run succeeded with no alerts.

The rule has no actions, so when it fires the alert only shows in Kibana and no one is notified. If you want an email or Slack message, it needs a connector added.
